expectations.name: wrong_sramx0_must_be_safe
expectations.rationale: Deliberately wrong: SRAMX0 is actually CHANGED on this ROM, so this should fail.

expectations.name: wrong_main_sram_must_be_zero
expectations.rationale: Deliberately wrong: main SRAM survives intact, so SAFE != ZERO -> should fail.

expectations.name: wrong_sramx1_must_not_be_changed
expectations.rationale: Deliberately wrong: SRAMX1 lower half IS the ROM scratch area -> should fail.

expectations.name: correct_sramx1_upper_safe
expectations.rationale: Sanity check: this one should still pass to prove the evaluator handles mixed results.
